evidence: As you wander through the exhibition rooms, you are surrounded by glass display cases, artifacts, and a slow stream of visitors moving through the quiet, solemn setting. Each artifact, whether a black-and-white photograph, an old leaflet, or a simple object once used by soldiers, tells a story of courage and sacrifice.
